description: The Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) of Aruba released its 2010 Population and Housing Census as a REDATAM database on the ECLAC-CELADE webserver. The living quarter file records utility information: electricity connection, water meter, telephone and cable connection, internet access by type, use of rainwater tanks, wells, plastic tanks and dams, the toilet drain, the number of air conditioners, the period of construction, number of floors, outer wall and roof material and the enumerator's rating of roof, wall, floor, ceiling and window quality. Results can be tabulated and mapped for the island's regions and zones. The census was taken in the week of 29 September to 6 October 2010 with short paper forms and long forms on netbooks, the long form used in 70 of 1,068 enumeration areas. Format and access: free online tables, graphs and maps without registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: some variables were asked only on the long form, and the CBS website redirected automated requests, so it was not read. Simulation uses: zone-level building quality and roof types for hurricane exposure, and electricity, water meter and cistern use for utility planning. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub and the Antigua and Barbuda 2011 census database.

schema_summary: Entities C2010 > GAC1 region > GAC2 zone > HOUSE (living quarter) > household > person. Living quarter variables include type, tenure, rent and whether electricity, water, gas, internet and cable are included in rent, period of construction, rooms, bathrooms, toilets and toilet drain, water use from rainwater tank, well, septic tank, plastic tank and dam, built-up and plot area, electricity connection, water meter, telephone and cable connection, internet by type, air conditioners, number of floors, outer wall and roof material, and quality of roof, walls, floor, ceiling and windows
